mainEntity.name: What services does Boundless Bolt offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boundless Bolt offers AI automation, agentic AI development, AI agents development, full-stack web development, mobile app development, blockchain development, website optimization, and custom software development services.

mainEntity.name: What technologies does Boundless Bolt use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use cutting-edge technologies including OpenAI, Claude, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch for AI; JavaScript, Next.js, React.js, Node.js, Golang for web development; MongoDB for databases; Solidity for blockchain; and Tailwind CSS for styling.

mainEntity.name: How can I contact Boundless Bolt?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can contact us via email at contact@boundlessbolt.com, call us at +234-903-585-3253, or fill out the contact form on our website. We're available Monday-Friday 9AM-6PM and Saturday 10AM-4PM.

mainEntity.name: Does Boundless Bolt work with international clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Boundless Bolt provides global services and works with clients worldwide. We offer remote collaboration and can adapt to different time zones.
